---
pagetitle: "Learn with Alf"
page-layout: custom
toc: false
anchor-sections: false
css: index.css
listing:
  - id: home-blog
    contents: "./post/*/index.qmd"
    type: default
    max-items: 5
    sort: "date desc"
    fields: [image, title, description, date]
    image-align: right
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
  - id: home-projects
    contents: projects/projects.yml
    type: grid
    grid-columns: 3
    fields: [image, title, description]
include-after-body:
  text: |
    <script>
    document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-post").forEach(function (post) {
      var title = post.querySelector(".listing-title");
      var meta = post.querySelector(".metadata");
      if (title && meta) title.insertAdjacentElement("afterend", meta);
    });
    </script>
---

<center><h1><i class="bi bi-heart-fill" style="color:#6f5499;"></i> My values</h1></center>

::: {.values-row}
::: {.value-card}
### <i class="bi bi-unlock-fill"></i> Open knowledge {.value-title}
All materials are published as Open Educational Resources, free and reusable by anyone.
:::
::: {.value-card}
### <i class="bi bi-patch-check-fill"></i> Rigor {.value-title}
Content is reviewed and updated continuously to offer clear, well-grounded explanations.
:::
::: {.value-card}
### <i class="bi bi-clipboard-data-fill"></i> Hands-on learning {.value-title}
Every topic comes with solved exercises and examples using real data to learn by doing.
:::
::: {.value-card}
### <i class="bi bi-arrow-repeat"></i> Reproducible science {.value-title}
I support Reproducible Science: I try to make sure that the decisions, design, methodology, data collection and procedures of my studies are clear and transparent enough to be replicated.
:::
:::
:::
